description: This file defines the BluetoothLeService class, an Android service responsible for managing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) GATT connections, handling data exchange, and broadcasting BLE events within an Android application.

classes.name: BluetoothLeService
classes.description: An Android Service class that manages BLE GATT connection lifecycle, data communication, and broadcasting BLE events.

classes.name: BluetoothLeService.LocalBinder
classes.description: A Binder class that provides clients with access to the BluetoothLeService instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes BluetoothManager and BluetoothAdapter for BLE operations.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a BLE device specified by its address.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the connected BLE device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases BLE resources by closing the GATT connection.

methods.name: readCharacteristic
methods.description: Reads data from a specified GATT characteristic.

methods.name: setCharacteristicNotification
methods.description: Enables or disables notifications for a GATT characteristic.

methods.name: getSupportedGattServices
methods.description: Returns the list of supported GATT services on the connected device.
